root_cause: The writer was not constrained to Slack's mrkdwn dialect, and source notifications used generic Backlog evidence/actions even for PR-ready items. CI check results and the PR URL were discarded, and delivered source messages did not refresh when evidence changed.
fix_summary: Normalize model-generated bold/bullets for Slack, preserve PR URLs and GitHub check evidence, use current List status for issue/bug actions, and edit existing notifications on evidence changes. Persist the original message channel so task-type changes do not misroute edits. Live repair evidence is recorded in STATE.md.
